name: fence-estimator-frontend
description: Frontend assets for the Fence Estimator single-page application.

scripts.build: node --input-type=module -e "import { cpSync, mkdirSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); mkdirSync('dist', { recursive: true }); cpSync('css', 'dist/css', { recursive: true }); cpSync('js', 'dist/js', { recursive: true }); console.log('Build complete: dist/');"
scripts.test: node --input-type=module -e "await import('./js/calculations.js'); await import('./js/validation.js'); await import('./js/storage.js'); await import('./js/ui.js'); await import('./js/api.js'); await import('./js/charts.js'); await import('./js/app.js'); console.log('Frontend modules imported successfully.');"
